sections.heading: Sarvajanik College of Engineering and Technology vs Uka Tarsadia University for B.Arch: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Sarvajanik College of Engineering and Technology if you want a recorded fee of ₹1.46 lakh, and an admission route through NATA - Exam, in a private B.Arch setting at Surat.
Choose Uka Tarsadia University if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹3 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹1.12 lakh, in a private B.Arch setting at Surat.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹1.46 lakh as a tuition figure for Bachelor of Architecture (B. Arch) at Sarvajanik College of Engineering and Technology. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

Our records show ₹1.12 lakh as a tuition figure for Bachelor of Architecture (B. Arch) at Uka Tarsadia University. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Sarvajanik College of Engineering and Technology here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

Uka Tarsadia University's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹3 LPA and a highest package of ₹4 LPA on Bachelor of Architecture (B. Arch). These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Sarvajanik College of Engineering and Technology is listed on our records with NATA - Exam as an admission route for this B.Arch comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Uka Tarsadia University is listed on our records with NATA - Exam as an admission route for this B.Arch comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Gujarat. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether Sarvajanik College of Engineering and Technology's recorded ₹1.46 lakh or Uka Tarsadia University's ₹1.12 lakh fits your budget for this B.Arch.

If you want a documented flagship placement year, Uka Tarsadia University is the clearer record here, because Sarvajanik College of Engineering and Technology has no 2020-or-later flagship package on this page.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
